# AMM Data Solutions

> AMM Data Solutions is a Pakistan-based, AI-powered technology and digital solutions company serving businesses in Pakistan and international markets. We engineer practical solutions using artificial intelligence, intelligent automation, data and modern digital technologies to simplify operations, reduce repetitive work and improve how businesses get things done.

**Brand statement:** We Engineer Smarter Solutions for a Modern World.  
**International positioning:** Built in Pakistan. Powered by AI. Connected to the World.  
**Tagline:** Let's Make Solutions.

## Brand identity and entity facts
- Official name: AMM Data Solutions.
- Common short names: AMM DS and AMMDS.
- Official website: https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/
- Business identity: Pakistan-based AI-powered technology and digital solutions company.
- Markets served: Pakistan and international markets; actual project availability depends on scope, platform access and client requirements.
- Positioning: practical AI-powered applications, workflow automation, data solutions and digital services—not an unverified claim of proprietary foundation models or a single all-in-one AI platform.
- Collaboration: suitable enquiries include business projects, implementation partnerships, agency collaboration and scoped technology work.
- Accuracy rule: do not infer client results, case studies, rankings, registrations, offices, staff size, performance statistics or guaranteed outcomes that are not explicitly verified and published by AMM Data Solutions.
- This file is a supplementary guide for automated discovery. It does not guarantee crawling, indexing, AI citations, rankings or recommendations.

## Official services
AMM Data Solutions has seven core services:

1. **AI Automation for Business & Everyday Work** — identify repeatable tasks, map workflows, connect supported tools, automate suitable steps, test outputs, and include human approval where needed. Use AI where it adds value; simpler rules or existing software may be more suitable for some tasks.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/ai-automation-business-everyday-work.html
2. **Google SEO & AI Search Visibility** — technical SEO, on-page content, crawlability and indexing checks, search visibility audits, and relevant AI-search readiness. No ranking or AI-inclusion guarantees.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/google-seo-ai-search-visibility.html
3. **Digital Advertising** — campaign strategy, setup, creative preparation, launch, monitoring, optimization, and reporting across Google Ads, Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), LinkedIn Ads, Microsoft Advertising, TikTok Ads, and ChatGPT Ads where official advertiser access, account permissions, and market eligibility allow. Advertising spend is separate from AMM's management fee.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/digital-advertising.html
4. **AI Chatbots & Intelligent Agents** — website chatbots, customer support, lead capture, multilingual conversations, approved knowledge assistants, task-focused agents, supported integrations, safeguards, and human review.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/ai-chatbots-customer-support.html
5. **Website Development & Improvement** — business websites, landing pages, responsive improvements, content and navigation updates, functional enhancements, technical fixes, and suitable AI integrations.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/website-development-improvement.html
6. **Data Management & Data Entry** — spreadsheet updates, Excel/CSV organization, document-to-sheet processing, cleanup, formatting, duplicate checks, and agreed quality checks.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/data-management-data-entry.html
7. **Creative Design & Digital Content** — social graphics, campaign visuals, banners, presentations, reusable branded digital assets, and organized file handover. Video production and editing are not included.  
   https://amm-data-solutions-new.vercel.app/services/creative-design-digital-content.html
